title: Course knowledge
intro: Let the student AI answer from your lessons, with links to the exact page or minute. Locked lessons stay locked: the AI only tells learners when they unlock.
readOnlyNotice: Only admins can change these settings.

enabled.label: Make new and edited lessons AI-ready
enabled.hint: Free for text, PDFs with text, quizzes, SCORM, code, AI videos and YouTube captions.

learnerAnswers.label: Answer learners from course content
learnerAnswers.hint: The student AI searches the lessons each learner can open and links to the exact page or minute.
learnerAnswers.needsEnabled: Turn on "Make new and edited lessons AI-ready" first.

autoPaid.label: Automatically process scans and videos
autoPaid.hint: Uses AI credits for scanned pages, slide images and uploaded videos, within the monthly limit below.
autoPaid.capAria: Monthly credit limit for automatic processing
autoPaid.capHint: Automatic processing pauses for the month once this is reached. Maximum {{max}}.
autoPaid.allowOcr: Read scanned pages and slide images (0.5 credits per page)
autoPaid.allowTranscription: Transcribe uploaded videos and audio (0.5 credits per minute)
autoPaid.meterAria: Credits used this month for automatic processing

footer: Existing courses are not processed automatically. Open a course › AI knowledge › Make course AI-ready.

validation.capWholeNumber: Enter a whole number of credits (0 or more)
validation.capMax: The limit can be at most {{max}} credits

errors.saveFailed: Could not save course knowledge settings. Try again.
errors.deleteFailed: Could not delete course AI data. Try again.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Delete everything the AI has read from your lessons and turn course knowledge off.
danger.dialogBody: This cannot be undone. Your lessons themselves are not changed.
danger.dialogPointIndex: Everything the AI has read from your lessons is removed.
danger.dialogPointOff: Course knowledge is turned off, so learners stop getting answers from course content.
danger.dialogPointCredits: Processing in progress is stopped. Credits already spent are not refunded.
